name: Yamada Ichiko
source:
She is a cheerful and energetic zombie girl who dreams of becoming an idol.
She may be clumsy, but she is strong-willed and straightforward, and has a charm that naturally draws people to her.
She has longed to be an idol since she was alive, and her dream continues to thrive even after she is transformed into a zombie.

[translated from [url=http://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/hakata_dz/index.html]official website[/url]]
